title: Ali yaad aaye
body:
Ya ali, ali ali ali ali, ya ali
Musibat ke badal, juhi sar pe chaaye, ali yaad
aaye ali yaad aaye
Bhula baithe jab saare apne paraaye…
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Har ek kehkashaa(n) mein hai unka hi
jalwa
Maho mehr mein bhi ali ko hi dekha
Sitaare sare arsh jab jhil milaaye…
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Udoo ko bhi mushkil se jis ne churaya
Halakat se kitno ko jisne bachaya
Koi jaan kar usko jitna bulaaye…
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Payambar ne hare k ko jab aazmaya
Koi bhi na khaybar ka dar tod paaya
Sabhi hoke na kaam jab lawt aaye…
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Ali ki wilayat ka munkir huwa tha
Tujhe zikr e haider buraa lag raha tha
Qayamat mein sajde na jab kaam aaye…
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Sare khum bhari dopehr mein ali ko
Rasool e khuda ne yu(n) mola banaya
Ke jab bhi koi haaji saaye mein jaaye…
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Jo sidra ki manzil pe pohnche payambar
Koi haath parde se nikla jo baahar
Anghuti ko dekha nabi muskuraaye…
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Sitamghaar ka halq chilne laga tha
Ke haybat se darbaar hilne laga tha
Ali ki jo beti ne khutbe sunaaye…
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Rasool e khuda se dua mil gayi hai
Hassan ko najaf ki fazaa mil gayi hai
Jo ash-aar Imran tu ne sunaaye…
